visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are positioned centrally against a plain white wall in a bright indoor setting. The man on the left, clad in a light-wash denim jacket, holds a pink-themed food package steady against his chest. The man on the right, wearing a black hoodie, performs dramatic, circular hand movements over the product. (2) As the man in the black hoodie continues his performance, a small white slip of paper with handwritten Chinese text begins to slide out from the side of the noodle box. The man in the denim jacket reacts with exaggerated wide eyes and an open-mouthed expression of theatrical shock. (3) The paper card extends fully, displaying promotional details about shipping and dates. The camera performs a slight digital zoom toward the text. The man in the black hoodie finishes with an open-palmed flourish toward the viewer, while the man in the denim jacket maintains his frozen surprised pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A whimsical, medium-tempo BGM featuring staccato orchestral strings and a playful flute melody begins immediately. A clear, high-pitched vocal track exclaims 'Abra Kadabra' with high arousal. A synthesized, sparkling chime sound effect with a wide frequency range ripples through the mix, synchronized with the vocal's ending. (2) The instrumental BGM maintains its steady, rhythmic pulse. The same vocal voice-over says 'Hocus Pocus' with a sharp, articulated delivery. A metallic, twinkling sound effect follows the voice, exhibiting high spectral brightness. The acoustic space is completely dry with no perceptible room reverb or background noise. (3) The vocal track continues with 'Alakazam' and a final, energetic 'Voila!' Each word is paired with a distinct, high-frequency magic twinkle SFX. The BGM concludes on a bright, major-mode tonal resolution. The sound design is crisp and post-produced, emphasizing the magical theme through layered, synchronized synthesized effects.
